hook.name: DegenSpyV3Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for SPY/token pools that collects custom swap fees via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapReturnsDelta, splitting proceeds between an operating treasury, a buyback vault, and per-pool beneficiaries. Pool registration and initialization are restricted to a privileged module address; the dynamic LP fee is refreshed on every swap.
